statements.text: BERT stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers.
GPT stands for General Pretrained Transformer.
statements.correction: GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer.

statements.text: The Transformer architecture was introduced by Google researchers in the paper "Attention Is All You Need".
The Llama family of open-weight models is released by Meta.
Gemini models are built by Google DeepMind.
Mistral AI, the company behind Le Chat, is headquartered in Berlin.
statements.correction: Mistral AI is headquartered in Paris.

statements.text: OpenAI's HumanEval benchmark contains 1,640 hand-written programming problems.
The MMLU benchmark covers 57 subjects, including mathematics, US history, computer science and law.
SWE-bench is built from real GitHub issues in 12 popular Python repositories.
DeepMind's AlphaGo beat Go champion Lee Sedol 4 games to 1.
AlphaFold, the protein structure prediction system, was built by OpenAI.
statements.correction: AlphaFold was built by Google DeepMind.

statements.text: OpenAI Five beat OG, the reigning Dota 2 world champions.
The JAX numerical computing library was developed by Microsoft Research.
TensorFlow was developed by the Google Brain team.
PyTorch was originally developed at Meta AI.
